parsed.english: For every viscosity nu > 0 there exist a smooth, divergence-free, rapidly decaying initial velocity u₀ and a smooth, rapidly decaying force f on ℝ³ such that no pair (v, p) is a smooth, finite-energy solution of the Navier–Stokes equations with data (u₀, f). Equivalently, every candidate pair (v, p) fails to be such a solution.
parsed.why_clearer: It replaces the negated existential over (v, p) with a universal quantifier over all candidate pairs, and writes ℝ³ as EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) so the statement does not rely on a local notation.
